snippet.title: Firearms Factory - Gameplay Trailer - FGS Live From GDC 2026
snippet.description:
Gameplay trailer for Firearms Factory. Firearms Factory is a WWII strategy game focused on weapon manufacturing and logistics. Firearms Factory is coming to PC in 2026.

Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1808960/Firearms_Factory/
